subject: Consolidating demo slots across region-specific holidays and OOO
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novato.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: Consolidating demo slots across region-specific holidays and OOO

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, Novato wants a single 60–75 minute walkthrough that includes both product and a short Q&A for engineering/security. Because your stakeholders span APAC, EU, and US and we’ve got several upcoming regional holidays (Golden Week in JP, Diwali in parts of APAC, and Easter bank holidays for the EU pilot team), I sketched a couple of consolidated options to minimize re-schedules and split sessions.

Quick ask: can you confirm which of the folks below are must-attend (engineering, security, procurement)? That will help us decide whether to run a single extended session at an awkward local hour or two shorter regional windows.

Proposed windows (all in local zones converted):
- Option A — One global session (75m): 2026-11-17 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 00:00 JST+1 (next day)
- Option B — Two regional slices (45m each): APAC block 2026-11-18 10:00 JST; EU/US block 2026-11-19 15:00 CET / 09:00 PT

I attached a quick availability tally and an .ics with those placeholders. If Golden Week or Diwali dates make those impossible, we’ll consolidate further.

Thanks — happy to iterate quickly.

— Ben Carter
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0113

Attachments: Proposed-demo-windows.ics, availability-tally.csv

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novato.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novato Demo Ops <demo-ops@novato.io>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@zenkai.co.jp>
Date: 2026-11-07T22:03:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating demo slots across region-specific holidays and OOO

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the options. A few clarifications from our side:
- Must-attend: myself (product), Kenji (APAC infra lead), and our security lead (Tara Patel, copied via demo-ops). Procurement will join if there’s a live pricing discussion later.
- Golden Week: Kenji is OOO 11/18–11/22 for Golden Week travel but is available for any local evening slot before 11/18.
- Diwali: our India team has a partial OOO on 11/14 and 11/15 (cannot attend).
- Easter bank holidays are in spring so not relevant to this November window — I think Ben you meant the EU late-November bank holidays? We have a small pilot team in Ireland who are out 11/23.

Given that, Option B's APAC slice on 11/18 won't work for Kenji. Our preference is Option A if you can shift it one day earlier to include Kenji (so try 11/16 or 11/17 depending on your calendar).

Also, if it helps, a recording plus a dedicated 30-minute APAC follow-up for tech deep-dive would be fine.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Product | Novato Solutions
Sophie.turner@novato.io

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novato.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:25:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating demo slots across region-specific holidays and OOO

On Sun, 8 Nov 2026, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novato.io> wrote:
> Given that, Option B's APAC slice on 11/18 won't work for Kenji. Our preference is Option A if you can shift it one day earlier to include Kenji (so try 11/16 or 11/17 depending on your calendar).

Hi Sophie —

We can absolutely do 11/16 or 11/17; thanks for flagging Golden Week and the India Diwali partials. Two follow-ups from our side:

1) Splitting content plan: we propose the single global session cover product + high-level security review (first 45 minutes) and then optionally break into two 15–20 minute parallel tracks (APAC technical Q&A with Aditya; EU/US commercial/questions with Grace). That allows Kenji to attend the product overview and then dial into the APAC track for the deep-dive on a recorded basis if needed.

2) DST note: US clocks fall back on 11/07 this year — we've already accounted for PT times in the .ics, but if any EU participants use CET switching to CET/CEST it shouldn't affect mid-November windows.

I’ve tentatively placed 11/16 at 16:00 CET / 08:00 PT / 00:00 JST (next day) and 11/17 at 16:00 CET / 08:00 PT / 00:00 JST+1 as alternates in the attached PDF. Please confirm which day works for Novato and which stakeholders must be present for the parallel tracks.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: Novato-Rolling-demo-plan.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novato.io>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@zenkai.co.jp>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T02:14:00+05:30
Subject: Re: Consolidating demo slots across region-specific holidays and OOO

Heads up on the technical plan and fallback options —

If we go with a single global session, I recommend we:
- Record the whole session and surface a 20-minute APAC technical digest (screen capture + track Q&A notes) within 24 hours.
- Prepare a short checklist for Kenji's APAC infra items to review asynchronously (I’ll include a pre-read).
- Have an on-call senior engineer (Monica) available for a 30-minute follow-up in APAC working hours the next day if we need to do live KV cache/latency proofing.

If we split sessions, we should keep the APAC deep dive within weekdays prior to 11/18 when Kenji is OOO. Otherwise the next earliest would be the week of 11/23 when the Ireland pilot team is out — that creates more friction.

I’ll prepare the pre-read and short recording template today; Laura, can you confirm whether Redwood can host the recording and the APAC follow-up slot in our demo calendar?

— Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T14:46:00+00:00
Subject: Final: 11/16 16:00 CET (global session) + APAC follow-up plan

Sophie —

Thanks for the quick replies and the holiday heads-up. Per the team’s availability and Kenji’s Golden Week OOO window, we’ll run the single consolidated session on:

• 2026-11-16, 16:00 CET / 08:00 PT / 00:00 JST (11/17 local JST dates) — 75 minutes total with an optional APAC deep-dive track immediately after.

Action items for Novato:
- Confirm attendee list for the main 75m session (product + security + Kenji please) — reply-all with final names so we can lock calendar invites.
- If Kenji prefers not to join live for the APAC deep-dive, we’ll record the main session and provide a 20-minute APAC summary + 30m follow-up office hours.

Internal notes: Laura will send the final calendar invite and two zoom links (combined session + APAC breakouts). Aditya will publish the pre-read and recording template. Monica is on standby for the APAC follow-up.

Sophie — let me know now if 11/16 is a hard no and we’ll pivot. Otherwise I’ll send the invite with the two link options.

Cheers,
Ben
